t: Robust Magnusson 1200mm box beam level designed for achieving highly accurate measurements. Features anodised aluminium construction, providing durability for site use, and shock-resistant rubber end caps to help protect from impact. The V-groove magnetic base securely attaches to metal surfaces and pipes, making it ideal for plumbing or steelwork. Solid block vials accurately indicate horizontal, vertical and 45° angles within a 0.5 mm/m measuring accuracy. Also features an ergonomic hand grip to ensure comfortable use whilst working.
b: High 0.5 mm/m Measuring Accuracy for Precise Work
Shock-Resistant Rubber End Caps Protect from Impact
